post.description: Get one document with collect id

put.description: Adding array of identities to one document

consent_to.description:
required: true
example: "Using my data for research"

birth_date.description:
required: true
example: 1970-01-01 TODO: Day, month, and year?

expiry_date.description:
required: false
example: Date (and if possible time)

picture.description:
required: false
example: facial image compliant with ISO 19794-5 or ISO 39794 specifications

sex.description:
required: false
example: 0 = not known, 1 = male, 2 = female, ...

document_data_validation.description:
required: false
example: file://path/to/schema.json or http://example.com/schema.json
format: string

real_data.description:
RealData is a flag to indicate if the document contains real data
required: true
example: true

revocation.description: Revocation is a collection of fields representing a revocation

scope.description:
Scope is the credential configuration ID scope
required: false
example: "ehic", "pda1"

vct.description:
VCT is the Verifiable Credential Type
required: true
example: "urn:eudi:pid:1"

id.description:
ID is the ID of the revocation
required: false
example: 8dbd2680-c03f-11ee-a21b-034aafe41222

reason.description:
Reason is the reason for revocation
required: false
example: lost or stolen

revoked.description:
Revoked is a flag to indicate if the document has been revoked
required: false
example: false

revoked_at.description:
RevokedAt is the time the document was revoked or going to be revoked
required: false
example: 509567558
format: int64

credential_configuration_id.description:
CredentialConfigurationID REQUIRED if a credential_identifiers parameter was not returned from
the Token Response as part of the authorization_details parameter. It MUST NOT be used otherwise.
String that uniquely identifies one of the keys in the name/value pairs stored in the
credential_configurations_supported Credential Issuer metadata. When this parameter is used,
the credential_identifier MUST NOT be present.

credential_identifier.description:
CredentialIdentifier REQUIRED when an Authorization Details of type openid_credential was returned
from the Token Response. It MUST NOT be used otherwise. A string that identifies a Credential Dataset
that is requested for issuance. When this parameter is used, the credential_configuration_id MUST NOT be present.

credential_response_encryption.description:
CredentialResponseEncryption OPTIONAL. Object containing information for encrypting the Credential Response.
If this request element is not present, the corresponding credential response returned is not encrypted.

proof.description:
Proof OPTIONAL. Single proof object for non-batch requests.
Deprecated: Use Proofs instead. This field is kept for backward compatibility with older wallets.

proofs.description:
Proofs OPTIONAL. Object providing one or more proof of possessions of the cryptographic key material
to which the issued Credential instances will be bound to. The proofs parameter contains exactly one
parameter named as the proof type in Appendix F, the value set for this parameter is a non-empty array
containing parameters as defined by the corresponding proof type.

enc.description: Enc REQUIRED. JWE enc algorithm for encrypting Credential Responses.

jwk.description: JWK REQUIRED. Object containing a single public key as a JWK used for encrypting the Credential Response.

zip.description:
Zip OPTIONAL. JWE zip algorithm for compressing Credential Responses prior to encryption.
If absent then compression MUST not be used.

challenge.description: Challenge MUST be the c_nonce value provided by the Credential Issuer (when provided)

created.description: Created is the creation time of the proof

cryptosuite.description:
Cryptosuite identifies the cryptographic suite used
Supported: eddsa-rdfc-2022, ecdsa-rdfc-2019, ecdsa-sd-2023, eddsa-jcs-2022, ecdsa-jcs-2019

domain.description: Domain MUST be the Credential Issuer Identifier

proofValue.description: ProofValue is the actual proof signature value

type.description: Type is the proof type, e.g., "DataIntegrityProof"

verificationMethod.description: VerificationMethod is a URL that identifies the public key to use for verification

cwt.description: CWT The CWT proof, when proof_type is "cwt"

jwt.description: JWT The JWT proof, when proof_type is "jwt"

ldp_vp.description: LDPVp The Linked Data Proof VP, when proof_type is "ldp_vp"

proof_type.description: ProofType REQUIRED. String denoting the key proof type.

@context.description: Context is the JSON-LD context, REQUIRED per W3C VC Data Model

holder.description: Holder is the DID of the holder

id.description: ID is an optional identifier for the presentation

proof.description: Proof contains the Data Integrity Proof(s), one of Proof or Proofs REQUIRED

proofs.description: Proofs contains multiple Data Integrity Proofs if more than one is present

type.description: Type is the type of the presentation, REQUIRED, must include "VerifiablePresentation"

verifiableCredential.description: VerifiableCredential contains the credentials being presented

attestation.description:
Attestation contains a single JWT representing a key attestation
as defined in Appendix D.1

di_vp.description:
DIVP contains an array of W3C Verifiable Presentations
signed using Data Integrity Proof as defined in Appendix F.2

jwt.description: JWT contains an array of JWTs as defined in Appendix F.1
